units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 58:6">Targ. Is. LVIII, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01901"><he>מַסְטֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:8">Targ. Prov. XX, 8</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:5">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>יבעי דִּינִי גבך</he> may my cause be required at thy hands, i.e. you wronged me, cmp. <cite ref="D00711"><he>דִּיקְיוֹן</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 39a:7">B. Kam. 39ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 117b">B. Mets. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>נחית לעומקיה דד׳</he> he enters into the depth of the case before him.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 173b:4">B. Bath. 173ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ דפרסאי</he> Persian law (arbitrary).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113a:1">B. Kam. 113ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ד׳ דמלכותא ד׳</he> the law of the (secular) government is law (must supersede the Jewish law in civil affairs).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83a:10">B. Mets. 83ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ הכי</he> is this the law? <cite ref="Berakhot 5b:17">Ber. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>דעביד ד׳ בלא ד׳</he> that He will pass sentence without justice (punish without cause).

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:18">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ד׳ דההוא גברא במאי</he> what is this man’s (thy) punishment (in the nether world)? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:6">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>אילו הוה הדין ד׳ וכ׳</he> if such a case would come up in your country.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דִּינְכוֹן אתיתי למחמי</he> (Tanḥ. Emor 6 <cite ref="D00693"><he>דיציבון</he></cite>, read: <he>דִּינֵיכוֹן</he> pl.) I came to see your administration of the law; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:1">Targ. Prov. XVII, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דִּינִין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 13:7">Targ. Y. Gen. XIII, 7</cite> [read:] <he>והוו דינין</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 1:10">Targ. Y. Ex. I, 10</cite> <he>בהלין ד׳</he> by what laws; a. fr.—[Y. Keth. IX, 33ᵇ bot. <he>דין מוגמרין</he>, v. <cite ref="D00450"><he>דִּיאֲטַגְמָא</he></cite>.]
